watch_list.summary: She didn’t have time in the AIE talk, so she points to her earlier thread: formal methods only prove the code matches the spec under assumptions, /statechart helps you check the agent got your intent, and you still layer types, tests, and formal methods together.

watch_list.short_title: Nuance tends to lead to slop
watch_list.summary: She boosted Matt Pocock’s takeaway from her AIE talk: nuance leads to slop, so design APIs and automated checks that take nuance out of agents’ decisions.

watch_list.short_title: Grok Bots can handle QuickBooks and Xero
watch_list.summary: Replying to a QuickBooks example, Lauren confirmed that Grok Bots can handle QuickBooks, and Xero too.
She amplified a recap video of Grok Bot 1.0 covering team bots, joining meetings, taking initiative, learning, and being smarter and faster.

watch_list.short_title: HTML-in-Canvas: wish for mobile and other browsers
watch_list.summary: After trying HTML-in-Canvas, Felix says the best APIs add a lot of power without many new concepts — easy for him and for LLMs — and his top wish is cross-browser and mobile support.

items.summary: A 15-minute beginner guide to CLI, MCP, and Skills: what each is for, whether engineers are shifting to the command line, and how to choose among these AI tools.
